notes:
% Path taken when user executes
% tg.connect and target computer
% is loaded but not running

% Path taken when user
% executes tg.start

% Path taken when user executes
% 'start' from target computer
% i.e. 'slrealtime start'

% Path taken when user executes
% tg.connect and target computer
% is loaded and running

% Path taken when user executes
% tg.connect and target computer
% is not loaded

% Path taken when user executes
% 'load' from target computer
% i.e. 'slrealtime load'

% Path taken when:
% 1) user executes tg.stop
% 2) user executes 'stop'
% from target computer
% i.e. 'slrealtime stop'
% 3) application stop time
% is reached

% Path taken when user
% executes tg.load

% Path taken when user executes
% tg.connect and target computer
% is loaded

functions.name: EnterUnloadedState
functions.body:
% The 'Unloaded' state may be reached by:
    %   1) tg.connect when target computer is not loaded
    %   2) tg.stop
    %   3) slrealtime stop
    %   4) tg.load when the load fails
    %
    % 1) fires the 'Connected' event because the user reached this state
    % by executing a connect action and the target computer happened to be
    % not loaded.  In this case, the user only expects to see a 'Connected'
    % event because that is the action they initiated.
    %
    % 2) and 3) fire the 'Stopped' event because the user reached this
    % state by explicitly executing a stop action, either from the tg
    % object or the target computer shell.
    %
    % 4) fires the 'LoadFailed' event because the user reached this state
    % by executing a load action from the target object, but the load
    % failed.
    %
   if connectInProgress_
        connectInProgress_ = false;
        notify(tg_, 'Connected');

   elseif loadFailedEV_
        loadFailedEV_ = false;
        notify(tg_, 'LoadFailed');

   else
        notify(tg_, 'Stopped');

        % Reload the application if 'ReloadOnStop' was specified in the
        % previous tg.start command.  The Stop Time used by the simulation
        % must be set after the application is re-loaded because it might
        % be different from what the application has saved.
        % 
        % Do not reload the application if an error occurs in the previous
        % run.
        %
        stopProps = tg_.get('StopProperties');
        if (stopProps.ReloadOnStop) && ...
                ~isequal(tg_.ModelStatus.State, slrealtime.ModelState.MODEL_ERROR)
            tc = tg_.get('tc');
            tg_.set('ReloadOnStop_StopTime', tc.ModelProperties.StopTime);
            try
                tg_.load(tc.ModelProperties.Application, ...
                    'AsynchronousLoad', true, 'SkipInstall', true);
            catch
                stoppedCleanup(tg_);
            end
        else
            tg_.set('ReloadOnStop_StopTime', []);
        end

        stoppedCleanup(tg_);
   end
end

function stoppedCleanup(tg)
    % tg_.load might throw an error
    % This code must execute to unblock UIs waiting for PostStopped

    % Clear out these properties set by the tg.start command
    tg.set('StopProperties', slrealtime.internal.TargetStopProperties);

    notify(tg, 'PostStopped');
end

functions.name: EnterNotRunningState
functions.body:
% The 'NotRunning' state may be reached by:
    %   1) tg.connect when target computer is loaded but not running
    %   2) tg.load
    %   3) slrealtime load
    %   4) tg.start when the start fails
    %
    % 1) fires the 'Connected' event because the user reached this state
    % by executing a connect action and the target computer happened to be
    % loaded but not running.  In this case, the user only expects to see
    % a 'Connected' event because that is the action they initiated.
    %
    % 2) and 3) fire the 'Loaded' event because the user reached this state
    % by explicitly executing a load action, either from the tg object or
    % the target computer shell.
    %
    % 4) fires the 'StartFailed' event because the user reached this state
    % by executing a start action from the target object, but the start
    % failed.
    %
    if connectInProgress_
        connectInProgress_ = false;
        notify(tg_, 'Connected');

    elseif startFailedEV_
        startFailedEV_ = false;
        notify(tg_, 'StartFailed');

    else
        % Set the correct stop time if this application was loaded by a
        % ReloadOnStop argument passed into the previous start command.
        %
        % tg.ModelProperties.StopTime will not show the new stop time if
        % checked from a user (or Explorer) 'Loaded' event callback because
        % the TargetControl object cannot write the stop time into
        % ModelProperties while in this 'ModelState' callback.  Therefore,
        % the new stop time is passed into 'Loaded' callbacks using event
        % data.
        %
        reloadOnStop_StopTime = tg_.get('ReloadOnStop_StopTime');
        if ~isempty(reloadOnStop_StopTime)
            % clear out the property after use
            tg_.set('ReloadOnStop_StopTime', []);
            tg_.setStopTime(reloadOnStop_StopTime);
            stoptime = reloadOnStop_StopTime;
            isReloadOnStop = true;
        else
            stoptime = tg_.ModelStatus.StopTime;
            isReloadOnStop = false;
        end

        notify(tg_, 'Loaded', slrealtime.events.TargetLoadedData(stoptime,isReloadOnStop));
        notify(tg_, 'PostLoaded');
    end
end

functions.name: EnterRunningState
functions.body:
% The 'Running' state may be reached by:
    %   1) tg.connect when target computer is loaded and running
    %   2) tg.start
    %   3) slrealtime start
    %
    % 1) fires the 'Connected' event because the user reached this state
    % by executing a connect action and the target computer happened to be
    % loaded and running.  In this case, the user only expects to see a
    % 'Connected' event because that is the action they initiated.
    %
    % 2) and 3) fire the 'Started' event because the user reached this
    % state by explicitly executing a start action, either from the tg
    % object or the target computer shell.
    %
    if connectInProgress_
        connectInProgress_ = false;
        notify(tg_, 'Connected');

    else
        notify(tg_, 'Started');
        notify(tg_, 'PostStarted');
    end
end
